text:
Alex: quick thought  we should make automatic fallback triggers pattern-aware, not just single-metric thresholds. compact operator UX that explains the pattern and suggests a one-click remediation.

Maria: sounds good. what kinds of patterns are you thinking about?

Alex: three primary patterns: SPIKE (sudden 5xx burst), DEGRADE (latency shift across p50..p99), PARTIAL (errors scoped to specific route/model). UI should call out which matched and why.

Jordan: For the modal: small header e.g. 'Pattern detected: SPIKE' + a one-line rationale, then 3 actions: Soft fallback, Hold, Open runbook. Soft fallback = route to compatible variant + keep sampled requests.

Kim: audit note  every action must create an immutable audit event with the trigger expression, operator, and TTL for overrides. compliance needs the exact condition recorded.

Alex: agree. show the trigger expression in the modal so SREs see what fired, e.g.:
```
{"trigger":"http_5xx_rate > 0.12 for 2m","scope":"/v1/generate","action":"fallback:vicuna-7b-q4_0"}
```

Maria: also show last ~10 matching events inline (timestamp + snippet) so operator can quickly eyeball noise vs signal.

Jordan: UX nit  primary suggested remediation should be one click; tuning thresholds should live in a secondary menu. don’t force advanced flows for common cases.

Kim: on rollout history, include a compact diff view: before/after routing entries and a CSV export for audits. overrides should list expiry and owner.

Alex: telemetry: show 'signal strength' (low/medium/high) with a link to raw chart. keep it lightweight so decisions aren’t blind.

Maria: compute signal strength from z-score + rule simplicity; tooltip explaining "why medium" is helpful.

Jordan: include a 'preview only' dry-run toggle. dry-run records matched requests and shows a sample but doesn't change routing. allows validation.

sre-bot: incident-bot: detected 18% 5xx across region-us-west in last 3m on /v1/generate (rolling window)

Alex: dry-run should expose a small histogram of matched user ids to detect a single noisy client.

Kim: override TTLs expire and auto-create a follow-up task for oncall to review.

Maria: system should suggest a revert when metrics stabilize; allow an auto-revert policy gated by confidence.

Jordan: auto-revert proposal: revert if error rate returns to baseline for 15m AND p99 < baseline+25%. all reverts are recorded.

Alex: action items:
- Alex: prototype compact modal with pattern header + actions + JSON preview + dry-run (due Tue EOD)
- Maria: design audit diff UI + CSV export + compliance notes (due Thu)
- Jordan: define dry-run backend contract for matched samples (due Fri)

Kim: adding security & SRE review to calendar. :calendar:

Alex: will drop Figma link when mock is ready. :thumbsup:
